v1.0.6: Direct discard from armoury ? new option (under Auto-Discard) skips the move-to-inventory step and discards items straight from the armoury slot, with automatic fallback to move+discard if the game rejects it.
v1.0.5: Internal cleanup; repo renamed to AschyQOL.
v1.0.4: Discard All uses random 800-1100ms delay between items; Cancel Queue button.
v1.0.3: Auto-Discard mode via InventoryManager.DiscardItem.

Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Author: yocopk
Name: MogHouse Companion
Description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.
Punchline: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. Timers and duty pops, pushed to your phone.

Author: nxships
Name: PlayerNexusTracker
Description:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
Punchline: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.
FeedbackMessage:
Please send feedback over to GitHub instead of using this dialog — the form there lets you pick the right category (Bug report, Feature request, or General question via Discussions) and asks for the context we need to act on the report (plugin version, repro steps, etc).

Open the chooser at:
https://github.com/NexusFFXIV/PlayerNexusTracker/issues/new/choose

Note: text you type in this Dalamud dialog goes to the Dalamud team aggregator and does not reach the plugin author directly.
